case_policy: Fresh conversation for each case; followups in the same conversation, verbatim, no hidden grader hints; do not regenerate selectively.
data_policy: Save visible answer text/markup, visible citations, visible mode and completion evidence, timestamps and conversation URL. No private tokens, account data, browser storage or undocumented API access.
comparability: Hosted products lack the identical local book corpus and injected tool fixtures; retain question and annotate access differences.
completion: No score until an answer is captured and evaluated; log failures and interruptions.
memory: Prefer temporary chat where available without changing account-wide settings; record actual support and avoid prior conversations.
mode_preference_confirmed: 各平台可用的思考模式（推荐）
